title: सोने की लंका रावण की थी ही नहीं
style: Painted-realism vector characters (remotion/src/kit/real.tsx) in lit 2.5D scenes; one camera through flat layers. Relaxed hanging hands (HP.hang), elbows at their default. NO subtitles, no text, no labels.

shots.title: Golden Lanka
shots.pick: Firelit night; golden Lanka glows; ten-headed Ravana stands proud before it. On 'नहीं' a gold crack splits the frame and the gold drains from behind him.

shots.title: Kubera
shots.pick: Golden palace; Kubera, lord of wealth, holds a treasure pot; coins rain and glint.

shots.title: Brothers
shots.pick: Split frame: Kubera (gold) and Ravana (red) side by side; they turn to look at each other.

shots.title: Father Vishrava
shots.pick: Lineage board: the rishi Vishrava's medallion; gold threads run down to Kubera and Ravana.

shots.title: Two mothers
shots.pick: Devavarnini joins Kubera with a gold thread; pan right: Kaikesi of the rakshasa clan joins Ravana with a red thread; Ravana's side turns red.

shots.title: Vishwakarma
shots.pick: Night sea; Vishwakarma raises his hammer and golden towers of Lanka rise out of the island, sparks flying.

shots.title: Rakshasas flee
shots.pick: Vishnu's Sudarshan chakra blazes in the sky; rakshasas flee and sink into the dark below; Lanka's lights go out, the city stands empty under the moon.

shots.title: Kubera settles Lanka
shots.pick: Rishi Vishrava blesses; Kubera walks toward Lanka and the city lights up window by window.

shots.title: Brahma's gift
shots.pick: Brahma on a lotus in the clouds blesses Kubera; gold coins pour; the Pushpaka descends in a glow.

shots.title: Visit to father
shots.pick: Kubera rides the Pushpaka over the sea to his father's ashram.

shots.title: Kaikesi's words
shots.pick: Night; Kaikesi points up at the glowing Pushpaka passing above and speaks to Ravana.

shots.title: Tapasya
shots.pick: Ravana sits in fierce tapasya among fires; flames rise higher.

shots.title: The message
shots.pick: Ravana, glowing with the boon, points toward Lanka and sends a burning message.

shots.title: Father's advice
shots.pick: Vishrava counsels Kubera: don't fight Ravana. Kubera bows his head.

shots.title: To Kailash
shots.pick: Kubera leaves Lanka in the Pushpaka toward the snowy peaks of Kailash.

shots.title: Ravana doesn't stop
shots.pick: Ravana roars, sword raised, fire behind him.

shots.title: Attack on Alaka
shots.pick: Ravana's sword clashes with Kubera's mace; Kubera falls; Ravana stands on the Pushpaka.

shots.title: Rama returns it
shots.pick: Rama and Sita fly to Ayodhya in the Pushpaka; then the Pushpaka glides back to Kubera.

shots.title: Taken
shots.pick: Golden Lanka and the Pushpaka: both were taken. Ravana's empty throne in Lanka as the Pushpaka glides away.
